cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Six losses! Our comeback will need its own documentary.

beats.speaker: A

mechanism: A assumes command of the comeback story and treats each new obstacle as material that will magnify the eventual victory, directing others to preserve rather than reduce that drama.
confusable: D209 calls loss a useful investment; D212 values how impressive the eventual comeback will look, not mainly what the loss teaches.
comparison: Disbanding team becomes a reunion narrative; cake collapse and failed oven become a deadline recovery story.
seedUse: Read both full cards and four canonical seeds. Preserve B real obstacles while making A authoritative response actively shape the imagined comeback instead of only praising it.
